selectionRules.note: Selected from generated books with valid startup previews, excluding accepted/corrected and known manual/blocked/suspicious slugs. Exactly 20 remaining generated-but-unaccepted books had raw source files resolvable under app/client/assets/temp-books, so the batch uses those 20 and does not force the remaining unresolved-source candidates. The set mixes chapter novels, story collections, single-story fairy tales, and one poem-like/short-form group where the local raw source and generated output could be inspected. No nonfiction/essay works remained in the eligible generated pool with resolvable raw source.

futureBatchRule: Every future processed book must include valid generated readable content.
The first default section must come from real readable content.
All main readable sections must be included by default.
Each book must have a valid book-specific startup preview.
Startup previews must not contain `SOS Help!`.
Startup previews must not use a generic preview fallback.
Default playback must not begin with title, TOC, source, license, contributor, or transcriber material.
